PR surface: Source +72, Tests +236. Total +308 across 8 files.

target.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to paragraph breaks in post md messages
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #97074.

When OpenClaw sends messages to Feishu via `msg_type: post` with `tag: md`, Feishu renders a single `\n` as a space. This causes assistant responses with multiple paragraphs or structured lines to appear cramped and unreadable.

## Why This Change Was Made

`buildFeishuPostMessagePayload()` normalizes the markdown text before sending:

- Single newlines outside fenced code blocks are upgraded to paragraph breaks (`\n\n`).
- Existing blank lines are preserved (no double-processing).
- Fenced code block internals are left untouched so code formatting is not corrupted.

To address ClawSweeper's review feedback, normalization is applied **after** card/table routing decisions are made on the original text, pre-normalized chunks are not normalized a second time, markdown tables are converted before chunking, and only the first post subchunk carries the reply target:

- Extracted `normalizeFeishuPostMarkdownNewlines` into `extensions/feishu/src/post-markdown.ts`.
- Reverted `feishuOutbound.chunker` to the raw `chunkTextForOutbound` so `renderMode=card` and auto-mode table detection run on unmodified text.
- Plain text post messages in `sendOutboundText` convert markdown tables, normalize after routing, then rechunk with `chunkTextForOutbound` against the 4000-character limit.
- Added `textIsNormalized` to `SendFeishuMessageParams` and `buildFeishuPostMessagePayload`. Callers that already normalize and chunk post-markdown text (outbound adapter and reply dispatcher) pass the flag so the final send path skips redundant newline normalization and markdown-table conversion, fixing normalized subchunk reply fanout.
- In `sendOutboundText` and `sendChunkedTextReply`, only the first subchunk receives `replyToMessageId`/`replyInThread`; later subchunks are message continuations and do not create additional replies.
- `buildFeishuPostMessagePayload` still normalizes by default for edit and direct-send paths.

This keeps the fix localized to the Feishu plugin while avoiding markdown-table mis-routing, oversized post chunks after newline expansion, double normalization of subchunks, and spurious multi-reply fanout.

## User Impact

Feishu channel users will see assistant responses with proper paragraph spacing instead of lines mashed into a single block, without delivery failures on newline-heavy messages near the 4000-character limit. Markdown tables and card-mode content continue to use the existing structured-card path; plain-text tables are converted before delivery.

## Evidence

Added regression coverage across the Feishu plugin:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/feishu/src/post-markdown.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts
```

Result: 176 tests passed, including:
- `post-markdown.test.ts`: 5 tests for newline upgrade, blank-line preservation, code-block preservation, no-op, and idempotence.
- `send.test.ts`: regression tests for `buildFeishuPostMessagePayload`, including the new `textIsNormalized` path.
- `outbound.test.ts`: tests verifying markdown table routing uses raw text, plain text gets normalized post newlines, normalized text rechunks within the 4000-character limit, pre-normalized chunks carry `textIsNormalized: true`, markdown tables are converted before normalization, and only the first subchunk uses `replyToId`.
- `reply-dispatcher.test.ts`: tests verifying plain text replies are normalized before chunking, card/table routing stays on raw text, message sends carry `textIsNormalized: true`, and only the first subchunk uses `replyToMessageId`.

Formatting check on the changed files:

```bash
./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/feishu/src/post-markdown.ts extensions/feishu/src/post-markdown.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/send.ts extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts
```

Result: all matched files use the correct format.

> Note: full `pnpm exec oxlint` is currently blocked in this environment by a project-config/dependency reconciliation issue (`Rule 'no-array-fill-with-reference-type' not found in plugin 'unicorn'` / pnpm install timeout), but `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --disable-unicorn-plugin` on the changed files reports 0 warnings and 0 errors.

### Redacted behavior proof

The branch was exercised locally with the Feishu post payload builder to show the newline rendering fix. No real tenant IDs, phone numbers, IPs, or endpoints are present.

Input text (single newlines between paragraphs, fenced code block):

```text
Paragraph one.\nParagraph two.\n\nAlready spaced.\n```\ncode line one\ncode line two\n```\nFinal paragraph.
```

Generated Feishu post payload (`msg_type: post`, `tag: md`) from this branch:

```json
{
  "zh_cn": {
    "content": [
      [
        {
          "tag": "md",
          "text": "Paragraph one.\n\nParagraph two.\n\nAlready spaced.\n\n```\ncode line one\ncode line two\n```\n\nFinal paragraph."
        }
      ]
    ]
  }
}
```

This demonstrates that single newlines outside fenced code blocks are upgraded to `\n\n`, existing blank lines are preserved, and fenced code block internals are left untouched.

A real live Feishu/Lark screenshot, API recording, or logs requires a tenant app ID/secret and a target chat/user that this environment does not have. The PR author cannot add live proof without those credentials; if a maintainer can provide a sandbox tenant or run the live proof step, I can attach a redacted screenshot/recording.
